description: Aligns the SPIKE blueprint with dedicated task worktrees and governed integration, and delivers lifecycle recovery and archival documentation.
delta: Replace the ambiguous throwaway Branch field and direct-to-main deliverable instruction with a canonical task branch and a separate optional local throwaway probe branch. Probe code is never merged or pushed; the canonical branch carries the deliverable and permitted lifecycle/evidence records through ordinary governed closure. Existing consumer task records are not rewritten. Add concise lifecycle documentation for proven commit-less fast-forward STALE_WORKTREE_BASE recovery with repair-base and renewed validation evidence, the exact Governed SDD SPIKE execution-evidence ledger exception, and conservative ### queue-section archival with recognized terminal rows and warnings for retained open or ambiguous sections. Both worktree-lifecycle markers become v3; other lifecycle template text is unchanged.
verification: The managed task-blueprint v16 distinguishes canonical task and local probe branches.
SPIKE deliverables use ordinary governed worktree closure rather than direct commits to main.
Consumer-owned text and historical task records remain unchanged.
Both managed lifecycle documents carry worktree-lifecycle v3 and explain repair-base and conservative queue-section archival.
Only the Governed SDD lifecycle document adds the SPIKE canonical execution-evidence ledger exception.
